name: top_tendsto_of_subseq_limits_unique
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (u : ℕ → X) (a : X) (h : ∀ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ → ∀ b : X, Filter.Tendsto (u ∘ φ) Filter.atTop (nhds b) → b = a) : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds a)
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (u : ℕ → X) (a : X) (h : ∀ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ → ∀ b : X, Filter.Tendsto (u ∘ φ) Filter.atTop (nhds b) → b = a), Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds a)
informal: In a compact metric space a sequence all of whose convergent subsequences have limit a converges to a — otherwise infinitely many terms stay ε-far from a; extract a subsequence of those, then a convergent sub-subsequence by sequential compactness, whose limit is ≠ a.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (u : ℕ → X) (a : X), (∀ (φ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono φ → ∀ (b : X), Filter.Tendsto (u ∘ φ) Filter.atTop (nhds b) → b = a) → Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds a)
